opening.argument: The presentation solicits purchases of complete or shared mining machines and places those purchases within a compensation structure explicitly described as “a hybrid system of a binary compensation system and a multi-level or multi-frontal compensation system.” It further promotes participation through pool access, linking $500 in pool 1 to four daily cycles, and promises recurring rewards from activity across eight levels, where a $200 cycle generates a $10 payment. Alongside these recruitment and repeated-purchase opportunities, it presents substantial earnings, including up to $2,000 per day and a claimed $5,000 Bitcoin withdrawal, then directs viewers to external websites and contact channels to participate. The presentation endorses these opportunities rather than reporting or criticizing them.
